conflicts.risk_explanation: compact should hold min(access_level) per (user,project). Trigger overwrites with NEW.access_level instead of min, backfill computes min but uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING so never repairs a stale higher value. Concurrent inserts/updates lose the minimum (last-writer-wins).

Backfill INSERT...SELECT races trigger DELETE: backfill snapshot taken before a revoke commits then inserts after the trigger deleted the compact row, resurrecting a ghost row. Conversely trigger DELETE removes the whole compact row even when sibling levels remain, over-deleting.

tests.rationale: DELETE trigger deletes whole compact row even when sibling (3,8,20) remains. Correct remainder is 20. Buggy interleavings leave compact absent, or backfill with stale snapshot reinserts min 10 including the deleted row.
